name: ado
description: OPTIONAL, DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Azure DevOps (work items, repos, pipelines, test plans) for teams that use ADO instead of GitHub. The core plugin is open-source and GitHub-first; enable this only if your org uses ADO. Preferred CLI: `az devops` (Azure CLI DevOps extension).

cli.note: CLI-first via the Azure CLI DevOps extension.

notes: Optional integration. The plugin's default providers are GitHub. Provider is selected by config.toolchain.issue_provider / git_provider. Never store the PAT here; use AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT.
